notes: *he hath given* is correctly `added`: כָּכֶם writes no verb, so no morpheme licenses a supplied lexical verb with its subject (rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause), and the ASV's own asterisks corroborate it under rule 7.

מִזְרַח and שֶׁמֶשׁ share the single English compound *sunrising* with the article taking the written *the* — exactly rule 30's `דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים` → *chronicles* shape, so the intervening article does not defeat the fusion; the supplied *toward* is the adverbial phrase's own under rule 33.
עַד אֲשֶׁר fuses to *until* headed on the governing opening morpheme (rule 23), and the four dative לְs left with no English are `unrepresented` under rule 40.
